🔄 I'd swap Triceps Pushdown for Lateral Raise. It puts very little load on the elbow joint, and it still works your shoulders on a push day. Tap Swap on the card to make the change. I skipped dips and overhead extensions because they usually bother a sore elbow more.

⚠️ Your bench and presses also load the elbow. Lower the weight and keep every rep pain-free. If the pain turns sharp or sticks around, stop and get it checked by a professional.
